limitations: Every failed or inconclusive observation remains blocking; later passes do not erase it.
Original TreeView closure and pre-binding startup failures are not attributed without a demonstrated reproduction.
Frame-boundary evidence applies only to its traced reproduction; desktop-wide DWM counters do not identify per-window pixels or physical scan-out.
Historical 250 ms and High Contrast requirements remain unchanged; proposed ADR 007 remains inactive.
